items.summary: 17.14 (a [PARTIAL] file last touched 2026-07-17) asserted supports-locked as an announce precondition and blocked announce on any open slot, citing a dangling '17.01.04 Q-01'. 17.01.04 — the [DEEP], 2026-07-30 file that OWNS the announce precondition set — explicitly rejected that rule (DT-05) and ratified lineup honesty in its place (P-04, D-06). One owning decision vs. one stale restatement: mechanical. Rewrote every location in 17.14 that carried the superseded rule to state lineup honesty, cited 17.01.04 P-04/D-06 inline the way the tree already does, and left the one genuine residual as tracked Q-04.

items.fixApplied:
Six locations in 17.14-bill-construction-support-slots.md rewritten to the canonical rule, plus a header date bump and one new tracked question:

1. Role Lens / Fan row (:25) — keeps the harm statement 17.01.04's own cross-cut note endorses ("17.14's Fan row states the problem exactly"), but re-aims it at a *named* unconfirmed act and names the mechanism: lineup honesty, not a locked bill, with a TBA slot promising the Fan nothing.
2. Happy Path step 4 (:49) — the bill row goes green on lineup honesty; an open slot satisfies P-04 the moment it is explicitly marked TBA; the bill does not have to lock for the show to announce.
3. Edge case "Bill has open slots at announce time" (:59, now :61) — inverted from "Announce is blocked" to "Not a block on its own", citing D-06/DT-05, with the block narrowed to a *named* unconfirmed act. The dangling "(17.01.04 Q-01)" citation is replaced with the live P-04 pointer, and the user-facing column now carries the canonical "mark as TBA" affordance from 17.01.04:176 instead of the invented "N support slot(s) still open" disable.
4. Edge case "Show announced, then a support drops out" (:60, now :62) — same contradiction downstream: it assumed every announced support was promised to the Fan. Now split named (the refund-rights case P-04 makes rare) vs TBA (routine bill work). The existing [PENDING] refill-vs-refund marker is preserved and scoped to the named case.
5. States table (:74-76) — `Partial` no longer says "announce blocked if it is a precondition"; a new `Announce-honest` state (every slot confirmed or explicitly TBA) is what the gate actually reads; `Locked` is demoted to the strongest bill state rather than the announce precondition; `Broken` is scoped to acts that were named at announce.
6. Cross-Cut Note to 17.01.04 (:89, now :92) — the assertion is inverted to lineup honesty with P-04/D-06/DT-05 cited, and states what this feature supplies to the gate (every named act confirmed, or the slot explicitly TBA).
7. New Q-04 added (4-column format preserved) for the one residual the canonical source genuinely does not answer: who may mark a slot TBA (D-03 slot-holder vs the two announce principals who benefit), and whether a TBA slot filled post-announce becomes "named" for refund purposes. Owner: User. Deferred to: /create-prd — cross-check 17.01.04 P-04 and 19.06.
8. Header `Last updated` 2026-07-17 → 2026-07-30.

No change was made to the canonical source (17.01.04). No new decision was authored in 17.14 — per the tree's handoff convention, the rule is referenced where it is owned, not copied. Scan of the whole shard confirms the drift was confined to 17.14: no other file restates supports-locked as an announce block.
